items.title: The localization of a ringed topos at a sheaf is a ringed topos with a canonical morphism to the original
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sites-modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma endows the localization of a topos at a sheaf F with a structure sheaf O_F, making it a ringed topos, and produces the canonical morphism of ringed topoi to the original, together with the expected descriptions of the functors involved. The proof imports from the sites-level localization lemma that the localized category is a topos and the basic properties, identifies the pullback of the structure sheaf with O_F using that lemma, and hence may take the structure map j_F^sharp to be the identity; it further reduces to the case where the site has finite limits with a subcanonical topology and F is representable, where the remaining description follows from the explicit description of the lower shriek functor (proof lines 2764-2782). H2: the identification of the structure sheaf and the reduction to the representable case are the substance.
